citations.assessment: Complete paragraph explicitly has Ebudami bar Tovi in Abbahu’s name, on tearing garments even for secondary mourning. Name spelling differs but kinship and report direction agree.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The source citation and transmission direction are supported by the full named paragraph, currently3:5:16. Preserve Tovi and Avudmi witness forms without inferring direct discipleship.
